review_comments:
/cc @SergeyKanzhelev 

`e2epod.NewPodClient(f).Create(ctx, pod)` will mutate the pod spec to set the node name before the pod is created.

As https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/128083#discussion_r1803935312 said,  I moved this test into `e2e/node` from `e2e/common/node` and changed the above code. 
```go
pod, err = f.ClientSet.CoreV1().Pods(f.Namespace.Name).Create(ctx, pod, metav1.CreateOptions{})
framework.ExpectNoError(err)
```
I didn't know that `e2e/common/node` will be triggered by node e2e tests. Sorry for that.
